prepared_for: Alexandra Whitfield-Okafor, Head of Field Marketing, Marigold & Moss
roster_status: 5 founding offices signed in Flatiron, NoMad and Union Square, about 420 people on a Tuesday; next drop Tue 2027-01-12, two founding places left
headline: 500 units into 10 New York offices in one week, within walking distance of the stores that carry you, with photos, feedback and a report.
lead: Trial here, buy there, measured. We place your product in offices that signed up to receive it, around Flatiron, NoMad and Union Square, and report back exactly what happened.
includes:
5 offices (founding) or 10 (standard) in one walkable cluster. No other brand in your category in the drop.
About 50 units per office, sized to Tuesday headcount, plus a 10% reserve for top-ups.
On the shelf within one business day, at eye level where the pantry allows, with a display card: your two sentences, your allergen statement word for word, and a QR code per office.
Five business days, starting on a Tuesday or Wednesday.
Two photos per office: placement on day 1, a close shot on day 3 or 5.
A three-question anonymous survey; each office commits to five or more responses.
A one-page report within seven business days, and a 20-minute debrief.
ladder_note: Each rung is reported on its own. We never call a scan a sale, and we do not claim lift.
fit:
Individually packaged, sealed, shelf-stable, with 60 or more days of shelf life at delivery.
Labeled with ingredients and the nine major allergens.
In a store inside or within ten blocks of the cluster, or online with a discount code.
Can ship 275 units to one Manhattan address within ten business days.
Carries product liability insurance.
The person we talk to can approve $600 alone.
A reason to want New York trial now: a new store, a launch, a local push.
excluded: Alcohol, cannabis or CBD, supplements, anything refrigerated or needing preparation, or products that make health claims.
send:
The product plus 10% reserve, freight prepaid, to one Manhattan address.
An ingredient and allergen sheet.
A product liability certificate, $1M or more, adding us as additional insured.
A discount code or landing page for the QR.
Your logo, and two sentences for the card.
never: **What we never promise:** sales, lift or new customers. We report what happened, rung by rung, and say what we could not measure.
next: **Next step:** a 20-minute call about your timing and the offices on the next route.
